03. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement.
2. In filing this I.A., the Opposite Party/Bank has sought for clarification of the order dated 11.12.2023 passed in W.P.(C) No.38417 of 2023.

3. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the Opposite Party/Bank.
4.

Leaned counsel for the Opposite Party/Bank submits that in filing this Writ Petition the Petitioner has cunningly mentioned only two criminal cases, whereas so many criminal cases are pending against her.

He further submits that despite the order of this Court dated 11.12.2023, the Bank authorities are unable to defreeze the bank account of Designation: Personal Assistant Reason:
Authentication the Petitioner as there are so many criminal cases pending Location: High Court of Orissa Date: 19-Feb-2024 17:37:10 against the Petitioner.

The criminal cases pending against the Petitioner are reproduced herein below:-

. Considering the above submission of learned counsel for the Opposite Party/Bank, this Court recalls the order dated 11.12.2023 passed in W.P.(C) No.38417 of 2023.
7.
This I.A. is, accordingly, disposed of.
8. On recall, heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the Opposite Party/Bank.

9. The Petitioner while filing this Writ Petition has sought for a direction from this Court to the Opposite Party/Bank for defreezing the Bank account bearing No.917010064309703, at Durgapur Branch, West Bengal in connection with the Bikrampur FCI, P.S. Case no.236 dated 15.09.2021 corresponding to G.R. Case no.1722/2021 pending before the court of learned S.D.J.M, Talcher,
Dist.-Angul and NALCO Township P.S.
Designation: Personal Assistant Reason: Authentication Case No.132 dated 04.07.2021 corresponding to G.R. Location: High Court of Orissa

Date:
19-Feb-2024 17:37:10 Case No.675/2021 pending before the court of learned // 3 // J.M.F.C,
Banarpal, Dist.-Angul for the offence under Sections 419/420/468/120(B) of the I.P.C.
10.Learned
counsel for the Petitioner submits that name of the Petitioner does not find place in the F.I.R., nor does it find place in the final report.

He further submits that since the name of the Petitioner is not connected with the crime in any way, defreezing her account paralyses her banking transaction and she has been prejudicially affected by such action.

11.Since on the last occasion learned counsel for the State also concurred that the name of the Petitioner does not find place in the final report, this Court considering the submissions of the parties, directs that the account of the Petitioner noted hereinabove be defreezed only in respect of the above mentioned two criminal cases, within a period of ten working days from the date of presentation of an authenticated copy of this order.
12.It is also made clear that if the Petitioner is found to be connected in respect of the aforesaid criminal cases, the concerned I.I.C. is free to take appropriate action in the matter.
Accordingly, the Bank shall freeze those accounts in accordance with law.
